svg.title: Nine elementary motility response rules
svg.desc: Nine isolated linear-response rules with a foraging sign convention. Orange: search when nutrient is scarce or the cell heads away from food. Blue: exploit when nutrient is rich or the cell heads toward food. Green: continuous steering onto the gradient. Gold is nutrient. Unlinked outlines are other realizations; a line is one trajectory.
